information.description:
Raptors make up the few Gunners that prove their prowess with firearms enough to be gifted better ones, which is rare for an Animal. Still, their higher competency, extra cybernetics, and usage of heavy sidearms makes them a slightly deadlier threat.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Animals).
